QuestInfo.name: Aftermath of the Curse
QuestInfo.0: It doesn't add up. You're awake, but the Curse of the Black Mage is still affecting the Elves, and for some reason your level is really low.
QuestInfo.1: Your low level must be a side effect of the Black Mage's Curse. You were in that ice cube for so long... You might be on the verge of death! Check your #bstatus#k, quickly!
QuestInfo.2: Aside from being Lv. 10, you were fine. Your injuries from fighting the Black Mage were all gone, and you still had the ability to level up.

default.0: ...I can't BELIEVE this! Why is this happening to me? To ME?! I'm the RULER of the ELVES, for Admin's sake!

1.0: Keep it together. Sure, I don't feel good about the lost levels, but you can still gain more experience!
